label: reconstructed-v2.0.0
limits: Reconstructed baseline, not a historical timing capture.
One frozen Orqalis corpus; not representative of every language or repository.
Read counts are Python open events, excluding Git/subprocess/kernel cache activity.
No real provider calls; token usage, autonomous task success, and model quality are unmeasured.
Latency is local warm-process wall time; no hardware resource cap is imposed.

skills.note: Serialized input bytes, not disk reads or tokenizer estimates. Routing is deterministic.
